basis: Revenue of $46.6m beat guidance of $44.0m and FactSet consensus, adjusted EBITDA beat both, full-year revenue guidance was raised to $200m, and the company reaffirmed Q4 EBITDA profitability. For a volatile, recently listed small cap, a clean beat-and-raise supports a mid-single-digit gain; the raise is smaller than it looks because it includes acquisitions.
